body: Greg's word (2026-11-07 19:23Z, Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #882), on a rustc INTERNAL COMPILER ERROR during a Windows B FULL ("the compiler unexpectedly panicked. This is a bug", item.rs:575) on byte-identical non-test source that had passed 80 min earlier, verbatim: „Jeszcze raz. Nic z tym nie zrobimy”. Asistant's gloss: don't hold the work for toolchain repair or change, create no extra diagnostic work, take the shortest permitted path, add no conditions. So for a plainly external toolchain crash (a compiler ICE, not a test failure), run the gate ONCE more without a diagnostic detour. This doesn't relax the rule for TEST failures: those are still diagnosed and fixed, never rerun until green.
